headline: OpenAI's new models surge; Poolside breaks records
summary: OpenAI's fresh trio—gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.6-terra, and gpt-5.6-sol—stormed the rankings today, with terra hitting an all-time high of 1.2% token share and luna climbing 7 spots in a week. Poolside's laguna-s-2.1 also set a new record at 1.4%, while Zhipu AI's provider share jumped 2.1 percentage points in a single day, now commanding 7.8% of the market.
highlights: Poolside laguna-s-2.1 hits all-time high: 1.4% token share
OpenAI gpt-5.6-terra sets record on day 2 of streak: 1.2% token share
OpenAI gpt-5.6-luna debuts at rank 17, up 7 spots in 7 days
Zhipu AI surges +2.1% provider share in one day to 7.8% total
DeepSeek still dominates at 20.8% despite -1.5% daily dip
Two OpenAI models dropped out; Zhipu AI's glm-5 and Google's gemini-3.5-flash-lite entered
